$comment: The declared shape of this app's runtime configuration. Names and purposes only —
never values, so this file is safe in Git and safe to read in a pull request.
Two checks keep it honest, because a manifest nobody verifies goes stale and then
scripts/ci/verify-env-manifest.mjs  every PR: this file matches what src/ reads
scripts/ci/verify-env-parity.mjs    before a production release: both Vercel
The point is that staging and production should differ only in credentials and
which resources they address, never in which variables exist. A variable present
in one project and missing from the other is drift, and it fails at runtime in
whichever environment is missing it — usually the one nobody is watching.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Supabase project REST endpoint. Differs per environment.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.purpose: Browser-safe Supabase key; RLS is what protects the data behind it.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Bypasses RLS. Server-side only: webhooks, crons, the health probe.

variables.name: SUPABASE_STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.purpose: LiveKit Egress writes recordings and transcript audio over Supabase Storage's S3 API.

variables.name: SUPABASE_STORAGE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.purpose: Pairs with the S3 access key id.

variables.name: SUPABASE_STORAGE_S3_REGION
variables.purpose: Storage region for the S3 endpoint. Defaults to us-east-1 in code if unset, which is usually wrong.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL
variables.purpose: LiveKit project websocket URL, also the host the server SDK derives.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Mints room tokens, starts egress, verifies webhook signatures.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
variables.purpose: Pairs with the LiveKit API key. Can mint a token for any room in its project.

variables.name: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Prerecorded transcription of each participant's audio.

variables.name: DEEPGRAM_MODEL
variables.purpose: Overrides the default nova-3 model, so a model rename needs no redeploy.

variables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Invoicing. Test mode on staging, live mode on production.

variables.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Verifies Stripe webhook signatures. Belongs to one endpoint, so it differs per environment.

variables.name: CRON_SECRET
variables.purpose: Bearer token Vercel Cron presents to the cron routes. Must differ per environment.
